key_findings: In three neuropathic pain models (oxaliplatin, partial sciatic nerve ligation, ciguatoxin-2), normally silent large-diameter DRG neurons gain de novo cold sensitivity, and most express Nav1.8 and CGRPalpha, identifying them as peptidergic nociceptors whose ablation halves cold hypersensitivity.
Blockade of Kv1 channels, primarily Kv1.1, is sufficient to unmask cold sensitivity in these neurons, while Nav1.8 and Nav1.7 are dispensable and Nav1.6 appears to be the predominant sodium channel.
